tspan.tspan: Bordeaux beats Champions Cup opponents by more than Glicko expects.
Each dot is one European cup match (2014-2026). Dashed line: margin Glicko would predict from rating differential.

text.style: opacity: 1; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: rgb(60, 60, 60); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;

g.text: Rating differential before the match (team's rating minus opponent's, including home advantage)
